rules.name: grasa-legacy-input-history-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT table_schema, table_name, table_type, table_rows, create_time, update_time FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND (table_name LIKE '%settlement_value%' OR table_name LIKE '%settle_value%' OR table_name LIKE '%input_security%' OR table_name LIKE '%bkp%' OR table_name LIKE '%backup%' OR table_name LIKE '%hist%') ORDER BY table_name

SELECT 'input_cache_cfs' AS tbl, MIN(value_date) AS min_date, MAX(value_date) AS max_date, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT value_date) AS dates FROM dbsystemuat.input_security_settlement_value_cache_table_cfs UNION ALL SELECT 'input_cfs', MIN(value_date), MAX(value_date), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT value_date) FROM dbsystemuat.input_security_settlement_value_table_cfs UNION ALL SELECT 'historical_cfs', MIN(value_date), MAX(value_date), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT value_date) FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs
